LESSON: TAKING AWAY

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.9: Taking away

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Taking away. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. collect different groups of similar objects or items
2. count objects in different sets to establish the number in each set
3. take away fewer objects from sets not more than 9
4. count the number of the remaining objects after taking away e) enjoy the activities of taking away objects and counting the remainders in the day to day life experiences taking away. away. objects form sets of objects not more than nine (9) using ICT devices. video programmes on the concept of taking away. NB: Ensure learners do not take away a number equal to the number of objects from the set.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. collect different groups of similar objects or items
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to collect different groups of similar objects or items. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. count objects in different sets to establish the number in each set

NB: Ensure learners do not take away a number equal to the number of objects from the set. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Taking away.
2. Explain Taking away to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Taking away.
4. Show that you can: collect different groups of similar objects or items
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Taking away. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Taking away important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
